description: AlphaFold model confidence (pLDDT, PAE) for ANXA2R plus dG(app) insertion benchmark against type I/II receptor, tail-anchored, GPI-anchored, peripheral and cytosolic control proteins

import requests, json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, re

# ================= AlphaFold DB model for Q3ZCQ2 =================
afd = requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q3ZCQ2", timeout=90).json()
e = afd[0]
print("AFDB entry:", e.get("entryId"), "| model v:", e.get("latestVersion"), "| len:", len(e.get("uniprotSequence","")))
pdb_url = e["pdbUrl"]; pae_url = e.get("paeDocUrl") or e.get("paeImageUrl")
pdb = requests.get(pdb_url, timeout=120).text
open("/tmp/AF_Q3ZCQ2.pdb","w").write(pdb)

# parse per-residue pLDDT from B-factor of CA atoms
pl={}
for line in pdb.splitlines():
    if line.startswith("ATOM") and line[12:16].strip()=="CA":
        pl[int(line[22:26])] = float(line[60:66])
res = sorted(pl); plddt = np.array([pl[r] for r in res])
print(f"\npLDDT: n={len(plddt)} mean={plddt.mean():.1f} median={np.median(plddt):.1f} min={plddt.min():.1f} max={plddt.max():.1f}")
for lo,hi,lab in [(0,50,"very low (<50, usually disordered)"),(50,70,"low (50-70)"),(70,90,"confident (70-90)"),(90,101,"very high (>90)")]:
    m=(plddt>=lo)&(plddt<hi); print(f"  {lab}: {m.sum()} res ({100*m.mean():.1f}%)")
hi_idx=[res[i] for i in range(len(res)) if plddt[i]>=70]
def segs(xs):
    out=[];
    for x in xs:
        if out and x==out[-1][1]+1: out[-1][1]=x
        else: out.append([x,x])
    return [(a,b) for a,b in out if b-a>=4]
print("  segments with pLDDT>=70 (>=5 res):", segs(hi_idx))
print("  mean pLDDT res 160-193 (hydrophobic C-term):", plddt[159:].mean().round(1))
print("  mean pLDDT res 1-159:", plddt[:159].mean().round(1))

# secondary structure from HELIX/SHEET records
helix=[l for l in pdb.splitlines() if l.startswith("HELIX")]
sheet=[l for l in pdb.splitlines() if l.startswith("SHEET")]
print("  HELIX records:", len(helix), "| SHEET records:", len(sheet))
for h in helix: print("   ", h[21:25].strip(), "-", h[33:37].strip())

# PAE
try:
    pae_j = requests.get(e["paeDocUrl"], timeout=120).json()
    P = np.array(pae_j[0]["predicted_aligned_error"], dtype=float)
    print(f"\nPAE matrix {P.shape}: mean={P.mean():.2f} A, median={np.median(P):.2f} A, max={P.max():.1f} A")
    print("  fraction of residue pairs with PAE < 5 A:", round(float((P<5).mean()),3))
    print("  mean PAE within res 160-193 block:", round(float(P[159:,159:].mean()),2))
    print("  mean PAE between res 1-159 and 160-193:", round(float(P[:159,159:].mean()),2))
except Exception as ex:
    print("PAE fetch failed:", repr(ex)); P=None

# ================= dG(app) benchmark vs controls =================
HESSA={'A':0.11,'C':-0.13,'D':3.49,'E':2.68,'F':-0.32,'G':0.74,'H':2.06,'I':-0.60,'K':2.71,
       'L':-0.55,'M':-0.10,'N':2.05,'P':2.23,'Q':2.36,'R':2.58,'S':0.84,'T':0.52,'V':-0.31,'W':0.30,'Y':0.68}
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
    'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}

def fetch(acc):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text
    return "".join(t.split("\n")[1:])

controls={
 "ANXA2R Q3ZCQ2 (query)":"Q3ZCQ2",
 "EGFR P00533 (type I receptor)":"P00533",
 "CD4 P01730 (type I receptor)":"P01730",
 "TFRC P02786 (type II receptor)":"P02786",
 "ITGB1 P05556 (type I receptor)":"P05556",
 "SEC61B P60468 (tail-anchored)":"P60468",
 "ANXA2 P07355 (peripheral membrane, Ca-dep)":"P07355",
 "GAPDH P04406 (cytosolic)":"P04406",
 "CNOT1 A5YKK6 (cytosolic partner)":"A5YKK6",
 "CD59 P13987 (GPI-anchored)":"P13987",
}
print("\n=== dG(app) benchmark: most favourable 19-aa window per protein ===")
print(f"{'protein':42s} {'len':>5s} {'min dG19':>9s} {'maxKD19':>8s}  segment")
bench={}
for name,acc in controls.items():
    s = SEQ_Q = fetch(acc)
    w=19
    vals=[(sum(HESSA[a] for a in s[i:i+w] if a in HESSA), i+1) for i in range(len(s)-w+1)]
    mn=min(vals)
    kds=[(np.mean([KD[a] for a in s[i:i+w] if a in KD]), i+1) for i in range(len(s)-w+1)]
    mx=max(kds)
    bench[name]=(len(s),mn[0],mx[0])
    print(f"{name:42s} {len(s):5d} {mn[0]:+9.2f} {mx[0]:8.2f}  {s[mn[1]-1:mn[1]+18]}")

# ================= figure =================
fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(11,10),sharex=False)
ax=axes[0]
x=np.arange(1,194)
kd19=np.full(193,np.nan)
for i in range(9,184): kd19[i]=np.mean([KD[a] for a in SEQ_Q0[i-9:i+10]]) if False else np.nan
S=("MEQHFLGCVKRAWDSAEVAPEPQPPPIVSSEDRGPWPLPLYPVLGEYSLDSCDLGLLSSPCWRLPGVYWQNGLSPGVQSTLEPSTAKPTEFSWPGTQKQQEAPVEEVGQAEEPDRLRLQQ"
   "LPWSSPLHPWDRQQDTEVCDSGCLLERRHPPALQPWRHLPGFSDCLEWILRVGFAAFSVLWACCSRICGAKQP")
for i in range(9,184): kd19[i]=np.mean([KD[a] for a in S[i-9:i+10]])
ax.plot(x,kd19,color="#2b6cb0",lw=1.8)
ax.axhline(1.6,ls="--",c="#c53030",lw=1); ax.text(3,1.67,"TM threshold (KD w=19 ~1.6)",color="#c53030",fontsize=8)
ax.axhline(0,c="grey",lw=0.6)
ax.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle (w=19)"); ax.set_title("ANXA2R (Q3ZCQ2): no window reaches the transmembrane hydropathy threshold")
ax.set_xlim(1,193)

ax=axes[1]
dg=np.full(193,np.nan)
for i in range(193-19+1): dg[i+9]=sum(HESSA[a] for a in S[i:i+19])
ax.plot(x,dg,color="#2f855a",lw=1.8)
ax.axhline(0,ls="--",c="#c53030",lw=1); ax.text(3,0.4,"dG = 0 (threshold for translocon insertion)",color="#c53030",fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("dG(app) insertion, kcal/mol\n(19-aa window, Hessa scale)")
ax.annotate(f"best window 168-186\ndG = +3.7 kcal/mol",xy=(177,dg[176]),xytext=(120,12),fontsize=8,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="black"))
ax.set_xlim(1,193)

ax=axes[2]
ax.plot(res,plddt,color="#6b46c1",lw=1.8)
ax.axhline(70,ls="--",c="#c53030",lw=1); ax.axhline(50,ls=":",c="#dd6b20",lw=1)
ax.text(3,71,"pLDDT 70 (confident)",color="#c53030",fontsize=8)
ax.text(3,44,"pLDDT 50",color="#dd6b20",fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT"); ax.set_xlabel("residue")
ax.set_ylim(0,100); ax.set_xlim(1,193)
ax.set_title(f"AlphaFold DB model: mean pLDDT {plddt.mean():.1f}, {100*(plddt<70).mean():.0f}% of residues below 70")
